sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: New Beginning (Prestige 4) is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Always good to see you on my doorstep! Not bored, are you? What, am I repeating myself again? Hey come on, it's just a little joke! Alright, down to business. The lists are constantly being updated, and you know our reputations are on the line. You know that you're not going anywhere in Tarkov without it. So we have to get this job done. I've just been handed the new list... What, you've already done some of these? Cool, easier for you. You gotta look on the bright side, brother! Otherwise, you're not gonna live long. Go ahead, show all those list makers how tough you are!"

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text:
- Must be level 40 to start this quest.
- Must have Prestige level 3

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Eliminate 20 PMC operatives
- Eliminate 30 Rogues
- Survive and extract from The Lab
- Use the transit from Streets of Tarkov to Interchange
- Survive and extract from Interchange
- Hand over 3 found in raid PMC figurines
- Hand over 3 found in raid Scav figurines
- Hand over 3 found in raid Boss figurines
- Hand over 3 found in raid Trader figurines

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +11,000 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.1
- 3,000,000 Roubles
  - 3,150,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 3,450,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 3× Physical Bitcoin
"Nice job, brother! Could have been quicker, but there was nothing in the task about time, so let's just ignore it."
